fields.Name: T296 - Integrations Auto-Map Schema Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the ToggleAutoMapPanel schema-wide auto-mapping config UI (LoadSchemas + AutoMapDirection) — a distinct toolbar panel separate from the manual Add-Map form.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. Click a connection card body to open its detail view, then click the 'Auto-Map Schema' button in the entity-maps toolbar. Verify an inline panel opens explaining it will auto-map all entities in a schema with 1:1 field mappings, showing a 'Target Schema' dropdown and Pull/Bidirectional/Push direction buttons plus an Auto-Map action and a close (X) button. Do NOT run the auto-map. Seeing the panel render with its schema selector and direction controls is success. If no connection exists, a clear empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking Auto-Map Schema opens a panel with a Target Schema dropdown and direction (Pull/Bidirectional/Push) buttons
The panel presents an Auto-Map action and a close/cancel control
OR a valid empty state is shown when no connection is available
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
